mapper.sql: id, plan_id, user_id, plan_date, title, subject, knowledge_point, estimated_minutes, due_at, status, priority, version, completed_at, deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM study_task WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM study_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY priority DESC, CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, due_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM study_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND plan_date = #{planDate} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY priority DESC, CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, due_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_task (plan_id, user_id, plan_date, title, subject, knowledge_point, estimated_minutes, due_at, status, priority, version, completed_at, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{planId}, #{userId}, #{planDate}, #{title}, #{subject}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{dueAt}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{version}, #{completedAt}, 0, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
